item.description: Fixed: the Open at login switch was greyed out on new installs and couldn't be turned on. New installs now start with Open at login and the System Monitor on; the welcome guide has a switch for each to turn them off. The monitor stays quiet until something's busy.

Keyboard shortcuts that work from any app: ⌃⌥T opens New Timer and ⌃⌥M opens or closes the mirror. Settings has a new Keyboard shortcuts section with a switch for each. Fixed: ⌃⌥N didn't open the quick note while clipboard history was on. Fixed: with the quick note open, its buttons could slide under the camera; copy and clear now sit in the note's corner.

Polish - The welcome guide covers Claude Code status and Today, and lets you turn on the weather, the System Monitor and clipboard history from the start. - VoiceOver reads Today and the clipboard history more clearly, and announces when you copy an item again. - Tested for 40 minutes with every feature running at once: no leaks, steady memory.
